description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, staff or operations only): act on a share from the operator view (POST /api/v1/admin/shares/:id/:action) — pause it, revoke it, release an abuse hold or override a quota — as a website.share@1 action. Every action writes website.share.paused or website.share.revoked and an audit row naming the operator; it can close an edge tunnel at once. Internal, never delegated, and never a way to read a share's traffic or secrets.
